name: Wanda Henderson
source: Wanda Henderson is a woman of faith who teaches at Lind Academy. She is a friend of the local nuns and is committed to sharing the Church’s message. As a professor she tries her best to guide students toward becoming better people. With the darkness spreading across town infecting her neighbors and students, she will need her faith more than ever.
